newsitem.title: UK: Cable Wireless no comment on alliance report.
newsitem.headline: Cable Wireless no comment on alliance report.

text.p: Cable & Wireless Plc said on Monday it would not comment on a Wall Street Journal report it was in talks on international cooperation with Sprint, France Telecom and Deutsche Telekom AG.
"Our position is we are not willing to comment on who we are speaking to," a C&W spokesman said.
"This is an industry where everbody's talking," the spokesman said, adding that in this context, C&W as a global company was uniquely placed.

The Wall Street Journal said that C&W was in talks to allow it to distribute to business clients Sprint Corp's Global One package of data and business phone services in exchange for use of C&W's telecoms infrastructure across the Atlantic and in the Pacific rim.

The report quoted France Telecom chairman Michel Bon as saying some sort of alliance which would allow C&W to distribute Global One's data products to corporate customers would be "logical". But Bon said he beleieved C&W was also in talks with other companies besides Global One.
